targets.rawSql:
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT d.device_id, e.timestamp_utc, e.system_health_jsonb
  FROM devices d
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT te.timestamp_utc, te.system_health_jsonb
    FROM telemetry_events te
    WHERE te.device_id = d.device_id
    ORDER BY te.timestamp_utc DESC, te.id DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) e ON true
  WHERE ('${device_id:csv}' = 'All' OR d.device_id IN (${device_id:sqlstring}))
), states AS (
  SELECT device_id, timestamp_utc,
    CASE WHEN timestamp_utc IS NULL OR timestamp_utc > now() OR timestamp_utc < now() - interval '20 minutes' THEN 'UNKNOWN'
      WHEN coalesce(system_health_jsonb->'watchdog', '{}'::jsonb) = '{}'::jsonb THEN 'UNKNOWN'
      WHEN system_health_jsonb #>> '{watchdog,configured}' = 'false' THEN 'OK'
      WHEN system_health_jsonb #>> '{watchdog,suppression}' = 'true' OR system_health_jsonb #>> '{watchdog,state}' IN ('suppressed','budget_exhausted','recovery_suppressed') OR coalesce(system_health_jsonb #>> '{watchdog,result}', system_health_jsonb #>> '{watchdog,state}', '') LIKE '%_failed' THEN 'ALERT'
      WHEN system_health_jsonb #>> '{watchdog,state}' IN ('starting','cooldown','maintenance','recovering','recovered','suppression_cleared') THEN 'WARN'
      WHEN system_health_jsonb #>> '{watchdog,state}' = 'healthy' THEN 'OK' ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END AS watchdog_status,
    CASE WHEN timestamp_utc IS NULL OR timestamp_utc > now() OR timestamp_utc < now() - interval '20 minutes' THEN 'UNKNOWN'
      WHEN system_health_jsonb #>> '{spool,status}' IN ('DEGRADED','CRITICAL') OR system_health_jsonb #>> '{spool,disk_status}' IN ('DEGRADED','CRITICAL') OR system_health_jsonb #>> '{spool,worker_state}' = 'error' THEN 'ALERT'
      WHEN system_health_jsonb #>> '{spool,status}' = 'BACKLOG' OR system_health_jsonb #>> '{spool,disk_status}' = 'WARNING' OR coalesce((system_health_jsonb #>> '{spool,pending_count}')::bigint,0) > 0 OR coalesce((system_health_jsonb #>> '{spool,backlog_count}')::bigint,0) > 0 OR coalesce((system_health_jsonb #>> '{spool,in_flight_count}')::bigint,0) > 0 THEN 'WARN'
      WHEN system_health_jsonb #>> '{spool,status}' = 'OK' AND system_health_jsonb #>> '{spool,disk_status}' = 'OK' AND system_health_jsonb #> '{spool,pending_count}' IS NOT NULL AND system_health_jsonb #> '{spool,backlog_count}' IS NOT NULL AND system_health_jsonb #> '{spool,in_flight_count}' IS NOT NULL THEN 'OK' ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END AS spool_status,
    CASE WHEN timestamp_utc IS NULL OR timestamp_utc > now() OR timestamp_utc < now() - interval '20 minutes' THEN 'UNKNOWN'
      WHEN system_health_jsonb #>> '{application,process_running}' = 'false' OR system_health_jsonb #>> '{application,systemd_service_active}' = 'false' THEN 'ALERT'
      WHEN system_health_jsonb #>> '{application,systemd_available}' = 'false' THEN 'WARN'
      WHEN system_health_jsonb #>> '{application,process_running}' = 'true' AND system_health_jsonb #>> '{application,systemd_available}' = 'true' AND system_health_jsonb #>> '{application,systemd_service_active}' = 'true' AND coalesce(system_health_jsonb #>> '{application,systemd_active_state}', 'active') = 'active' THEN 'OK' ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END AS application_status
  FROM latest
)
SELECT device_id,
  CASE WHEN 'ALERT' IN (watchdog_status, spool_status, application_status) THEN 'ALERT' WHEN 'WARN' IN (watchdog_status, spool_status, application_status) THEN 'WARN' WHEN 'UNKNOWN' IN (watchdog_status, spool_status, application_status) THEN 'UNKNOWN' ELSE 'OK' END AS overall_status,
  watchdog_status, spool_status, application_status,
  CASE WHEN timestamp_utc IS NULL OR timestamp_utc > now() THEN 'UNKNOWN' WHEN timestamp_utc < now() - interval '20 minutes' THEN 'STALE' ELSE 'FRESH' END AS freshness_status
FROM states ORDER BY device_id

SELECT d.device_id, CASE WHEN e.system_health_jsonb #>> '{watchdog,suppression}' IN ('true','false') THEN (e.system_health_jsonb #>> '{watchdog,suppression}')::boolean ELSE NULL END AS suppression, CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(e.system_health_jsonb #> '{watchdog,attempt_count}') = 'number' THEN (e.system_health_jsonb #>> '{watchdog,attempt_count}')::bigint END AS attempt_count, CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(e.system_health_jsonb #> '{watchdog,restart_count}') = 'number' THEN (e.system_health_jsonb #>> '{watchdog,restart_count}')::bigint END AS restart_count, CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(e.system_health_jsonb #> '{watchdog,reboot_count}') = 'number' THEN (e.system_health_jsonb #>> '{watchdog,reboot_count}')::bigint END AS reboot_count FROM devices d LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT te.system_health_jsonb FROM telemetry_events te WHERE te.device_id=d.device_id ORDER BY te.timestamp_utc DESC, te.id DESC LIMIT 1) e ON true WHERE ('${device_id:csv}' = 'All' OR d.device_id IN (${device_id:sqlstring})) ORDER BY d.device_id

SELECT now() AS time, d.device_id || ' telemetry' AS metric, CASE WHEN e.timestamp_utc IS NULL OR e.timestamp_utc > now() THEN NULL ELSE extract(epoch FROM now()-e.timestamp_utc)::double precision END AS value FROM devices d LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT te.timestamp_utc FROM telemetry_events te WHERE te.device_id=d.device_id ORDER BY te.timestamp_utc DESC, te.id DESC LIMIT 1) e ON true WHERE ('${device_id:csv}' = 'All' OR d.device_id IN (${device_id:sqlstring}))

SELECT d.device_id, CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(e.system_health_jsonb #> '{spool,pending_count}')='number' THEN (e.system_health_jsonb #>> '{spool,pending_count}')::bigint END AS pending_records, CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(e.system_health_jsonb #> '{spool,backlog_count}')='number' THEN (e.system_health_jsonb #>> '{spool,backlog_count}')::bigint END AS backlog_records, CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(e.system_health_jsonb #> '{spool,in_flight_count}')='number' THEN (e.system_health_jsonb #>> '{spool,in_flight_count}')::bigint END AS in_flight_records, CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(e.system_health_jsonb #> '{spool,dead_letter_count}')='number' THEN (e.system_health_jsonb #>> '{spool,dead_letter_count}')::bigint END AS dead_letter_records, CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(e.system_health_jsonb #> '{spool,oldest_pending_age_seconds}')='number' THEN (e.system_health_jsonb #>> '{spool,oldest_pending_age_seconds}')::bigint END AS oldest_pending_age_seconds, CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(e.system_health_jsonb #> '{spool,outage_duration_seconds}')='number' THEN (e.system_health_jsonb #>> '{spool,outage_duration_seconds}')::bigint END AS outage_duration_seconds, CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(e.system_health_jsonb #> '{spool,database_size_bytes}')='number' THEN (e.system_health_jsonb #>> '{spool,database_size_bytes}')::bigint END AS database_size_bytes, CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(e.system_health_jsonb #> '{spool,free_space_bytes}')='number' THEN (e.system_health_jsonb #>> '{spool,free_space_bytes}')::bigint END AS free_space_bytes, CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(e.system_health_jsonb #> '{spool,disk_usage_percent}')='number' THEN (e.system_health_jsonb #>> '{spool,disk_usage_percent}')::double precision END AS disk_usage_percent FROM devices d LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT te.system_health_jsonb FROM telemetry_events te WHERE te.device_id=d.device_id ORDER BY te.timestamp_utc DESC, te.id DESC LIMIT 1) e ON true WHERE ('${device_id:csv}' = 'All' OR d.device_id IN (${device_id:sqlstring})) ORDER BY d.device_id

SELECT timestamp_utc AS time, device_id || ' restart' AS metric, (system_health_jsonb #>> '{watchdog,restart_count}')::double precision AS value FROM telemetry_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp_utc) AND jsonb_typeof(system_health_jsonb #> '{watchdog,restart_count}')='number' AND ('${device_id:csv}' = 'All' OR device_id IN (${device_id:sqlstring})) UNION ALL SELECT timestamp_utc AS time, device_id || ' reboot' AS metric, (system_health_jsonb #>> '{watchdog,reboot_count}')::double precision AS value FROM telemetry_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp_utc) AND jsonb_typeof(system_health_jsonb #> '{watchdog,reboot_count}')='number' AND ('${device_id:csv}' = 'All' OR device_id IN (${device_id:sqlstring})) ORDER BY time

SELECT timestamp_utc AS time, device_id AS metric, (system_health_jsonb #>> '{spool,backlog_count}')::double precision AS value FROM telemetry_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp_utc) AND jsonb_typeof(system_health_jsonb #> '{spool,backlog_count}')='number' AND ('${device_id:csv}' = 'All' OR device_id IN (${device_id:sqlstring})) ORDER BY time

SELECT timestamp_utc AS time, device_id || ' watchdog' AS metric, CASE WHEN coalesce(system_health_jsonb #>> '{watchdog,result}', system_health_jsonb #>> '{watchdog,state}', '') LIKE '%_failed' THEN 'recovery_failed' WHEN system_health_jsonb #>> '{watchdog,state}' IN ('healthy','starting','cooldown','maintenance','recovering','suppressed','budget_exhausted','recovery_suppressed','recovered','suppression_cleared') THEN system_health_jsonb #>> '{watchdog,state}' ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END AS state FROM telemetry_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp_utc) AND ('${device_id:csv}' = 'All' OR device_id IN (${device_id:sqlstring})) UNION ALL SELECT timestamp_utc AS time, device_id || ' spool' AS metric, CASE WHEN system_health_jsonb #>> '{spool,status}' IN ('OK','BACKLOG','DEGRADED','CRITICAL') THEN system_health_jsonb #>> '{spool,status}' ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END AS state FROM telemetry_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp_utc) AND ('${device_id:csv}' = 'All' OR device_id IN (${device_id:sqlstring})) ORDER BY time
